label: Devon clotted cream
note: Disputed origin with Cornwall; paler because the grass has less carotene (Wikipedia); in Devon the cream goes on the scone first, in Cornwall the jam; only Cornish clotted cream is a PDO (1998, min 55 % butterfat, milk from Cornwall)

about.text: Clotted cream from Devon, the rival of the Cornish in the origin dispute; paler, since the grass has less carotene. In Devon the cream goes on the scone first, in Cornwall the jam.

sources.text: The first paragraph of its article, shortened.
